summary: Every HTML element is drawn as a rectangle. The box model describes the layers of that rectangle: content, padding, border, and margin.
notes: <section> groups related content with its own heading.
<div> is a plain box with no meaning. Use it when no semantic tag fits, like these demo boxes.
Each box's text tells you how its width is calculated, so you can compare it with the preview.
pitfall:
Adding empty
tags or blank paragraphs to make space. Use margin and padding in CSS instead.
